header.title: pegRNA design table
header.caveat: Predictions from a published model, meant to narrow what is tested at the bench. Not experimental results. The independently recomputed field reflects an evaluator run on the same machine as the miner, using the same model; cross-machine reproduction has been checked on a 200-row sample, not every row.
header.license: CC BY 4.0. Cite as: LIFE Compute, pegRNA design predictions, 2026-10-14, model sha256_16 d215f65a7727cf9f.
missing_standard_fields: hgvs_c -- no CDS-level HGVS notation is recorded
hgvs_p -- no protein-level consequence is recorded
chromosome / genome_build / genomic_coordinate -- source offsets index a RefSeqGene accession, not GRCh38; no chromosomal position is available
pam_sequence -- only the PAM offset is recorded, not the bases
nicking_sgrna -- no PE3/PE3b second-nick guide is designed
scaffold_sequence -- the pegRNA scaffold is not stored with the candidate
off_target_score -- no off-target search has been run
mmr_status -- MMR-proficiency of the intended cell line is not recorded
pbs_tm / rtt_tm -- melting temperatures are model-internal features, not emitted in the candidate rows
clinvar_id / dbsnp_id -- no variant database cross-reference
